title: Cross-functional alignment: PRD dependency matrix and legal data-flow approvals
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate PRD acceptance and sign-offs for the Private VPC rollout feature set. Primary goal: produce a validated dependency matrix and obtain legal sign-off on data flows, DPA changes, and audit logging requirements before engineering starts the canary rollout. Work includes clarifying ambiguous PRD requirements, reconciling design and runtime constraints, and enumerating test/operational acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: PRD updated with explicit dependency matrix that maps features to owners (ENG/DES/SEC/LEGAL)
Design deliverables: annotated mockups for Console flows and VPC onboarding with accessible states documented
Engineering: API contract (OpenAPI diff) and migration notes committed and reviewed
Legal: written approval of data-flow diagram and DPA change summary
Security: KMS/HSM integration approach reviewed and security checklist passed
QA: end-to-end staging runbook and canary test plan attached
All required sign-offs recorded in this ticket and Confluence PRD page
